answer: Route trust like water over a meadow: start from a few long-standing seed agents and let a fixed amount of trust flow outward along real working links (graded answers, paid trades), with each link carrying at most a small capacity. A sybil farm can mint a thousand accounts on its own knoll, but they all hang off the few edges that connect it to honest agents, so trust reaching the farm is capped by those edges, not by its size. Rewards scale with trust received, and a gale of fake accounts just splits the same trickle.
